gen.title: How change in momentum becomes force and acceleration
gen.orderNote: Follow the derivation in the order the page presents it from momentum to acceleration

steps.label: change in momentum (mass times velocity) per change in time
steps.quote: His second law defines a force to be equal to change in momentum (mass times velocity) per change in time.
steps.orderHint: Track momentum change turning into acceleration

steps.label: Momentum is defined to be the mass m of an object times its velocity V
steps.quote: Momentum is defined to be the mass m of an object times its velocity V.
steps.orderHint: Track momentum change turning into acceleration

steps.label: F = (m1 * V1 – m0 * V0) / (t1 – t0)
steps.orderHint: Track momentum change turning into acceleration

steps.label: mass stays at a constant value equal to m
steps.quote: Let us assume that the mass stays at a constant value equal to m.
steps.orderHint: Track momentum change turning into acceleration

steps.label: F = (m * (V1 – V0)) / (t1 – t0)
steps.orderHint: Track momentum change turning into acceleration

steps.label: F = m * a
steps.orderHint: Track momentum change turning into acceleration
